class.name: ECSComponentSchema
class.brief_description: A component type declared as a resource.
class.description: Describes an ECS component (name, typed fields, flags) without code. Create one from the editor (New Resource > ECSComponentSchema), add fields in the inspector, then list it in [member ProjectSettings.ecs/components/schemas] so every [ECSWorld] registers it on creation and the [ECSPrefab] inspector offers it. Schemas can also be registered at runtime with [method ECSWorld.register_schema]. Fields are stored natively in archetype columns exactly like components registered from code with [method ECSWorld.register_component].

method.name: add_field
method.description: Adds (or retypes) a field. [param type] is a [enum Variant.Type] or [constant ECSWorld.FIELD_TYPE_ENTITY].

method.name: get_field_names
method.description: Returns the field names in declaration order.

method.name: get_field_type
method.description: Returns the type of a field, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_supported_type_names
method.description: Returns the type names understood by [method type_from_name] ([code skip-lint]bool[/code], [code skip-lint]int[/code], [code skip-lint]float[/code], [code skip-lint]String[/code], math types, [code skip-lint]Color[/code], [code skip-lint]Variant[/code], [code]Entity[/code], ...).

method.name: has_field
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the schema declares [param name].

method.name: name_from_type
method.description: Returns the display name of a field type.

method.name: type_from_name
method.description: Returns the field type for a display name (case insensitive), or [code]-1[/code].

members.member: Name of the component type. Must be unique across built-in components and other schemas.
Field name to type map ([enum Variant.Type] integers or [constant ECSWorld.FIELD_TYPE_ENTITY]). Edited with the dedicated inspector control.
Combination of [enum ECSWorld.ComponentFlags]: sparse storage, replication, owner authority, unreliable transfer.
